summaries.Romania: Romania faces a political crisis with President Nicușor Dan conducting consultations on premier nomination after 135+ days without a government, while the healthcare system struggles with a 98-million-lei deficit and inflation hits 6.3%—the highest in the EU.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation is accelerating with AI-driven tools transforming patient care coordination and chronic disease management, while regulatory challenges mount around prior authorization systems and Medicare Advantage denial rates continue rising.
summaries.Tech: Apple's iOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate launch with major AI and health improvements, skipping to 27.2 betas within days; meanwhile, AI companies race to scale infrastructure with data center partnerships, and regulatory scrutiny intensifies around AI safety and deployment practices.

items.title: Președintele Nicușor Dan, anunț în scurt timp după consultările cu partidele pentru desemnarea premierului

items.line: Romania's political crisis enters critical phase as Nicușor Dan holds consultations to break 135-day government deadlock and designate a new premier.

items.title: Humana study links pharmacy care coordination to lower costs, fewer hospitalizations for cancer patients
items.snippet: Humana researchers found that cancer patients who received specialty pharmacy care coordination services had fewer hospitalizations and emergency department visits, along with lower medical costs.
items.line: Humana research confirms that specialty pharmacy care coordination significantly reduces hospitalizations and costs for cancer patients, validating AI-driven care models.

items.title: Oura, Counsel Health join CMS ACCESS model to test whether wearables and AI can improve chronic care at scale
items.snippet: Counsel Health, an AI-native primary care company, plans to participate in CMS' ACCESS Model under the early cardio-kidney-metabolic track, with smart ring maker Oura serving as the preferred wearable partner.
items.line: CMS ACCESS model expands to test wearables and AI for chronic disease management at scale, signaling major shift toward value-based digital health.

items.title: CMS extends ACCESS model to more chronic conditions as agency officials eye cross-payer alignment
items.snippet: The Trump administration is rapidly expanding its 10-year ACCESS Model, a value-based payment program that reimburses digital health companies based on patient outcomes rather than services delivered.
items.line: Trump administration rapidly expands CMS ACCESS model to cover more chronic conditions, accelerating value-based payment for digital health companies.
